subtasks.title: 梳理拒绝→重拆的完整状态流转与计数生效点
subtasks.description: 基于子任务1的定位，按时间顺序还原流程：(a) 用户通过 approve_run 提交 reject + feedback；(b) 计划状态被置为 rejected 并持久化（storage.save_plan / update_run_state）；(c) 控制循环回到规划节点，读取 rejection 计数；(d) 若计数 < MAX_PLAN_REJECTIONS 则携带 feedback 重新调用 _generate_specs 生成新计划并 _record_version（reason=rejection）；(e) 若计数 >= MAX_PLAN_REJECTIONS 则终止/转人工，说明具体分支与返回状态。同时说明计数在何处递增、是否持久化（run state 还是 plan 字段）、是否跨进程/重启保留。只读分析。

336| def save_plan(run_id: str, plan: dict[str, Any], db_path: Path | None = None) -> None:
337|     goal = _goal_payload(plan)
338|     with _connect(db_path) as conn:
339|         # BEGIN IMMEDIATE makes the freeze check and the write ONE transaction
340|         # across processes. Without it the read is not part of the write
341|         # transaction, so two runners can both see "no goal yet" and the second
342|         # commit silently replaces the first runner's frozen goal. (Within a
343|         # process ``_DB_LOCK`` already serializes, but that lock is process-local.)
344|         conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
345|         row = conn.execute(
346|             "SELECT goal_json FROM run_plans WHERE run_id = ?", (run_id,)
347|         ).fetchone()
